title: Why didn't Scooby-Doo stop La La Land from winning the wrong Oscar?
post: La La Land was announced instead of Moonlight at the 2017 Oscars... so why didn't Scooby-Doo stop it? Would you trade the biggest night in Hollywood for half a sandwich? 👇 #scoobydoo #oscars #lalaland #moonlight #didyouknow #funnyfacts
